Ground truth & measurement log

Optional

Reference distance from the camera center to the selected tag center. Applies only to the tracked tag. Changing it or the tracked tag starts a new trial.

0 samples · Mean — m · Total SD — m

Statistics use all valid raw distances in the current trial, not just saved rows. Total SD is sample standard deviation (n − 1), blank for fewer than two samples. Keep the tag at a fixed distance during a trial. New camera sessions and imported images start a new trial.

Spreadsheet logging (CSV)
Download CSV

Imports a copy. Requires this app’s column format; unrelated spreadsheets and XLSX files are not modified.

Each row saves the selected tag’s displayed and raw distances, ground truth, errors, trial statistics and full metadata. Blank ground truth leaves error columns blank. Logging is manual; enabling the checkbox adds one row per frame download.

No spreadsheet writes until you append a measurement or enable logging on frame download.

Processed locally. Frames are saved only when you download them.Distance: camera center → tag center. Analysis rate is not camera FPS.
